description: Will my prior credits apply as credit at my target school? For each thing a person holds (an AP, CLEP or IB exam and its score, or a course taken at a school) the target school's own published transfer rules (CourseAtlas) and CollegeBoard's reported AP policy, in three states: covered (a rule carries it to a course at the target), missing (the target's own rule needs a higher score), unknown (no rule held; never a guess). Each covered item names the course it lands as, every rule with its minimum score and dates, how many rules agree, and the target's programs whose checklists require that course. A case to argue, not a verdict; recognition is the school's act. Each row names its current FORM's wording source: source_url, capture_file, catalog_year and source_catalog_name are that one source's, never the record's whole span. A row whose record holds more than one form or more than one source also carries version_count, source_count, first_edition_seen and last_edition_seen, and one sentence saying so in words; a record with one form and one source carries none of them and reads exactly as it always has. The forms themselves, each with its own content and its own sources, come from the one-record get, never from a list. A record last seen in an older edition says so, because the Union keeps a record no current catalog prints.

checklist_id.description: Optional: the target program's checklist id; the answer then names the lines each covered item addresses

held.description: 1 to 20 things held: an exam { program: AP|CLEP|IB, exam: its code (e.g. AP 3700) or title (e.g. United States History), score }, or a course { unitid or school, code as printed (e.g. HIS 110) }

target_unitid.description: The target school's IPEDS UNITID, e.g. 216038

name: will_my_credits_transfer

items.description: One per held item: held, read_as, state (covered|missing|unknown), reason, lands_as (course, learning_unit_id, rules, corroboration, band, satisfies), statement

limits.description: What this answer could not do, each { code, statement }

title: Will My Credits Transfer
